Ways to cast

Say the incantation while you swish your wand

Draw a spell in the air with your Magic Caster Wand. When the camera starts, the wand's tip lights up bright white and the magic flare follows it. To draw, show a sign with your other hand — no screen tapping. Keep the sign up while you draw the shape with the wand, then drop your hand to cast.

Your spell lessons

🪄 A better wand cast

Hold your wand with thumb and index finger on the grip. Draw one clear shape, then lift your thumb to release the spell. In camera mode, keep the glowing tip visible and draw large shapes.

Official wand grip tutorial

Wizarding games

Play with your wand in front of the camera — its tip glows white and the magic follows it. The camera stays on in every game. Your glowing wand tip steers the magic; connected wand spells work too. Game videos are saved by default, ready to download or share. Microphone recording is optional.

ⓘ Video formats

MP4, WebM, Ogg, MOV and other video files can be added. Playback depends on the video and audio codecs inside the file and this browser. MKV, AVI and WMV may not play. If a file fails, try an MP4 with H.264 video and AAC audio. No conversion is performed.

🎙 Voice

What to say

“Go to example dot com” · “Search for cats” · “Back” · “Forward” · “Scroll down” · “Scroll up” · “Home” · “Reload” · “Zoom in” · “Zoom out” · “Clear address” · “Open address” · “Stop listening”.

Commands are in English. Recognition uses your voice language in Settings and may need an internet connection. Voice typing fills the address box; press Go to open it.
